addLanguage.title: Add a language
addLanguage.body: Languages are file-based today. A developer wires the locale, then its strings are translated here. Live in-app editing is a planned follow-up.

addLanguage.step2: Add the code to the middleware matcher in the customer, vendor and admin apps.
addLanguage.step3: Create packages/i18n/messages/'<code>'/ and translate each namespace; missing keys fall back to English.
